To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the neutrino flavor ratios arriving at the Earth from WIMP annihilation in the sun's interior are (a) sensitive to the WIMP decay channel, (b) sensitive to θ 13, (c) sensitive to δ, and (d) sensitive to the mass hierarchy.

the flavor ratios of the ν e and ν μ fluxes at the Earth, for neutrinos produced by WIMP decay in the sun's interior, are determined by the mixing parameters θ 13, δ, and the mass hierarchy, while the ν τ flux at the Earth is independent of θ 13 and δ.

(i) the neutrino flavor ratios at the Earth are sensitive to WIMP models; (ii) the neutrino and antineutrino ratios are not identical for WIMP decay; (iii) flavor ratios are sensitive to θ 13, even if θ 13 ≪ 1; and (iv) the mass hierarchy can be inferred by comparing ratios for neutrinos and antineutrions

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the neutrino flavor ratios arriving at the Earth from solar annihilation of WIMPs are diagnostic of WIMP annihilation models.

the flavor ratio of ≥ GeV neutrino fluxes at the Earth is sensitive to the neutrino mass hierarchy, the mixing phase δ, the neutrino mass-squared differences, the solar WIMP annhilation channel, the solar WIMPs' velocity, and the solar WIMPS' density profile.
the flavor ratios at the Earth for ≥ GeV WIMP neutrinos are sensitive to all three mixing angles, the mass hierarchy, the CP-violating mixing phase, and the WIMP model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for neutrino production in the sun's interior, the matter effects on the flavor ratios of neutrinos arriving at the Earth are significant and are sensitive to θ 13, θ 32, and δ.

the flavor ratios of the ≥ GeV neutrino fluxes arriving at the Earth can be used to infer the WIMP annihilation channel, the neutrino mass ordering, the neutrino mixing angle θ 13 and, to a limited degree, the CP-violating mixing phase δ.

the flavor ratios of neutrinos from WIMP decay in the sun can provide a unique signature, and can be used to distinguish among WIMP models, as well as to determine θ 13 and to infer the mass hierarchy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the case of solar neutrinos from WIMP annihilation, flavor ratios can be used to distinguish between different WIMP models.
the flavor ratios of solar neutrinos are a sensitive probe of WIMP annihilation in the sun, and that the flavor ratios can be used to infer θ 13 and δ.
flavor ratios are a useful tool for distinguishing between different WIMP models and, in the future, for determining neutrino mixing parameters.
